page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.2xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. Powered by a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8475B processor, it delivers 8 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 16.0 GB of system memory. This hardware allocation yields a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 2.0 GB of RAM per core, positioning the server specifically for compute-bound processing tasks rather than memory-heavy applications.

The instance provides no local storage bundled by default, requiring external network-attached block volumes for persistent data storage. Network infrastructure features a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Lacking discrete GPUs, hardware acceleration is unavailable for specialized graphics or matrix workflows. The absence of integrated local NVMe SSDs reduces local storage latency advantages but simplifies instance scaling and decouples storage management.

Offering a lean memory allocation alongside dedicated high-frequency vCPUs, ecs.c8i.2xlarge delivers cost-efficient compute capacity for workloads that demand predictable CPU execution without extra memory overhead. Ideal deployment scenarios include distributed application nodes, batch processing jobs, web application backends, web serving, and Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) build pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server configured with 8 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at 2.7 GHz. Managed by the KVM hypervisor, it features 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a 1:2 CPU-to-RAM ratio with 2.0 GB per vCPU. The instance carries no bundled local storage, relying on cloud block storage for persistence, and includes a baseline network throughput of 6 Gbps with no complimentary public IPv4 addresses or hardware GPU accelerators. With its focused resource distribution prioritizing dedicated vCPU resources over memory volume, ecs.c8i.2xlarge presents a cost-effective infrastructure choice for compute-intensive tasks where high RAM footprints are unnecessary. This configuration is well-suited for web serving, compute-heavy microservices, batch processing operations, software compilation, and CI/CD build environments.
